svg.title: A relative placement follows its parent, and a virtual placement draws through placeholder cells
svg.text: A: a relative placement follows its parent
before
parent
child
The child is made with P and Q naming the parent,
and H=4, V=1: four columns right and one row down
from the parent's top left cell.
after the screen scrolls up two rows
parent
child
Both moved together; the child keeps its offset.
Deleting the parent deletes the child, and the
child's image when it has no placement left.
B: a Unicode placeholder draws a virtual placement
virtual placement: image 42, U=1, c=2, r=2
no position, on no line
the text: U+10EEEE in foreground color 42
each cell: a row diacritic, then a column one
the frame: one entry for each row
top half
bottom half
after tmux redraws its pane two columns right
The cells moved as text, and the picture with them.
The picture is fitted to c by r cells with its aspect
kept. The cell's background shows where the picture
is transparent, and the cell draws no glyph.
Diacritics left out are taken from the cell to the left,
so a cell cut by the line's cluster budget still draws
its own part of the picture.
